summary: Fixed one spec-backed defect in validation.py run_validation(): a per-shot error (e.g. release_y<0) whose actual_outcome was 'miss' was counted as an agreement/true-negative, contradicting DATA_SPECIFICATION.md §3.4 and the module docstring ('error rows count as binary disagreement'). Changed the error sentinel from pred_bin='miss' to pred_bin=None so match=(pred_bin==actual_bin) is always False, excluded error rows from the 2x2 confusion matrix, and tracked n_actual_made separately so p_actual_made stays correct. No-error path is provably identity-preserving (n_actual_made==tp+fn; p_pred_made formula unchanged). Verified: import validation OK; in-memory compile OK; test_core.py 13/13 PASS; correlated-dummy selfcheck 100% agreement/kappa 1.0; error probe now 0% agreement & tp/fp/fn/tn=0/0/0/0 (was 50% & 0/0/1/1); valid_data_3D 0/35 unchanged. NOTE: the task brief described validation.py as a trajectory/RMSE comparator, but the actual file (and README/DATA_SPECIFICATION) define it as a classification validator with no 2D path — no trajectory metrics, no hard-coded paths, and no 2D/3D constant mixing exist to fix.
